content.comment_body: Hello, I'm encountering an error with the "PI Trend View" while running online test mode. The error appears after a random interval—sometimes 10 seconds, other times 10 minutes. While it makes sense for the error to occur if values are directly modified on the device, it's frustrating that it happens even when only viewing the process. Restarting the online test and re-enabling PI Trend View often helps temporarily, but the error recurs unexpectedly and closes the live view. My setup: Windows 7 64bit [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] USB to [product_name] cable [product_name] [article_no] (ES5, according to firmware check) I've updated the configuration through the update center, but I think only some language files changed since I'm already on the latest version. Transferring the program to and from the device doesn't resolve the issue.

Hello, Is the hardware selected in [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] the same as what is actually connected? Try all three hardware settings available for [product_name] [article_no]. The E-Stand version is labeled on the device (to the left of the input field, below the ESC and OK buttons). The cross indicates the E-Stand version. Close any other open applications in [product_name] Soft Comfort, stop all other simulations or connections, and try again to see if the issue improves. Hope this helps.

I've tried Standard, ES3, and 5—no change. The firmware check consistently shows [article_no].ES5, and when transferring the program: *** PC --> [product_name] [article_no].ES5 :-) Download completed Are you referring to "[article_no]"? I don't see any other relevant info on the device. For your information, I have the 24C version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report sporadic disconnects and errors with the PI Trend View feature in online test mode when using [product_name] Soft Comfort and [product_name] [article_no]. The problem interrupts live data monitoring, occurring even without user changes, and persists despite matching hardware and software versions as well as updates. This suggests possible instability or compatibility issues affecting live testing and data trends.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want reliability and continuous live process monitoring through PI Trend View during online test mode, without unexpected errors or loss of connection.
